neighbours.label: The Arabic article 'al-' (or 'lil-') fused with a following alef/hamza as its own word-piece (الأ, الإ, للأ) at the start of a less common Arabic word; 'al-' words that begin with another letter, and very common al-+alef words the tokenizer keeps whole, stay dark.

neighbours.short: Arabic al-/lil- + alef/hamza word-piece (الأ, الإ, للأ)
neighbours.notes: Stepped in from bonsai1/L31/N2543+ (play step --down): N3175 was listed with drop 0.00 on its - pole, which is dense (51.6% of tokens >0.1 max, max 3.2) and untestable; this test labels the sparse + pole of the same cell instead. Feeders-first: top feeders L29/N12050- (alef-hamza piece after clitics) and L27/N3526+ (split-off Arabic word-opening pieces). Test sentences written blind by a label-only author.

predictions: Most fire sentences 0.5-0.7; plain 'al-' near misses around 0.1-0.4, risk from other clitic pieces (لل, بال) and the shared الأطفال.
